name: PredictBot Bet9ja All-Sports Evidence Capture
description: Stage 1 of a separate, all-sports/all-fixtures Bet9ja capture tool (distinct from the existing Soccer-only bet9ja_capture extension): captures a raw, unparsed DOM snapshot of an already-open, already-authenticated Bet9ja page for building real per-sport fixture parsers against, rather than guessed selectors. No network requests, no account data, no bet placement, no cashout, no fixture parsing yet.
